items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Describe what you want and the AI generates everything. If you want to tweak the code, you have a full editor, but it's not required.

items.q: How long does it take to generate my website?
items.a: Between 5 and 15 seconds. The AI generates complete, professional HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

items.q: What happens to my domain if I cancel?
items.a: You have a 30-day trial period after cancellation. Your site stays active. If you don't reactivate, the domain is released and data is deleted automatically.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. The Pro plan includes automatic purchase and setup of a .com domain. You can also use a free subdomain on pagepolis.com.
Yes. The generated HTML/CSS/JS code is yours. You can copy it and host it anywhere.
